eventName: Planting of 50 banyan saplings on the banks of Mudichur Lake on the occasion of 79th Independence Day
eventDescription:
Seventy-nine years ago, our nation attained freedom.
Yet today, our natural resources still stand on the verge of destruction.

For the air that future generations will breathe,
the water they will drink,
and the Earth they will live on to remain free?
we plant trees today,
so that tomorrow, they may give us life.
